明治神宫
明治神宫建成于上世纪二十年代，供奉明治天皇与昭宪皇太后，位于东京市中心却绿树成荫。神宫周边约十万棵树的森林由日本各地捐赠、年轻志愿者种植，穿过鸟居便仿佛与都市喧嚣隔绝。苑内有菖蒲花田、风景优美的林间小道、古典日式茶舍，以及被视为能量圣地的清正井。神宫内设有大量英文标识，方便初次体验神社参拜、绘马与护身符等传统仪式。

东京国立博物馆
东京国立博物馆成立于十九世纪后期，是日本历史最悠久的博物馆，位于上野公园内。馆藏规模庞大，涵盖众多国宝及重要文化财产，常有大量文物同时展出。展品涉及武士盔甲与刀剑、江户时代工艺、能剧歌舞伎、茶道与佛教等主题；主楼后方的日式庭园向公众开放，内有传统茶屋。

上野公园与阿美横丁
上野公园位于上野车站旁，是上野一切体验的中心，公园及周边聚集了上野动物园、多座博物馆与宽永寺。公园内世界级的美术馆与画廊包括国立西洋美术馆、东京都美术馆、国立科学博物馆，以及介绍百余年前东京生活的下町风俗资料馆。公园南侧的阿美横丁汇集各式市场摊位与街边小吃，氛围热闹。

Meiji Shrine
Completed in the 1920s, Meiji Shrine enshrines Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken, and stands amid lush greenery in central Tokyo. The roughly 100,000-tree forest around the shrine was donated from across Japan and planted by young volunteers; passing through the torii gate feels like leaving the city's noise behind. Within the grounds are an iris garden, scenic woodland paths, a classical Japanese tea house, and Kiyomasa's Well, regarded as a power spot. Tokyo National Museum
Founded in the late nineteenth century, the Tokyo National Museum is Japan's oldest museum and is located in Ueno Park. Its collection is vast, covering many National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties, with large numbers of artifacts often on display. Exhibits span samurai armor and swords, Edo-period crafts, Noh and Kabuki, tea ceremony and Buddhism; behind the main building, a Japanese garden with a traditional tea house is open to the public.

明治神宫建成于上世纪二十年代，供奉明治天皇与昭宪皇太后，位于东京市中心却绿树成荫。神宫周边约十万棵树的森林由日本各地捐赠、年轻志愿者种植，穿过鸟居便仿佛与都市喧嚣隔绝。苑内有菖蒲花田、风景优美的林间小道、古典日式茶舍，以及被视为能量圣地的清正井。神宫内设有大量英文标识，方便初次体验神社参拜、绘马与护身符等传统仪式。

text.overview:
This two-day itinerary is built around your interests in culture, history, temples and museums, and a relaxed pace: the destination is Tokyo, November 3–4, with your own flights (no flight arrangements needed), and the whole-trip budget target is understood as you described it.

Day 1 focuses on Asakusa: in the morning enter Senso-ji through the Kaminarimon gate, stroll slowly along Nakamise Shopping Street and try street snacks; in the afternoon to dusk, walk along the Sumida River area, and in the evening experience the illuminated Senso-ji and the down-to-earth food and drink of Hoppy Street.

Day 2 morning goes to Meiji Shrine, to worship in the shrine set within an urban forest and write an ema votive plaque; in the afternoon move on to the Tokyo National Museum in Ueno Park to see collections on Japanese history and crafts; toward evening you can stroll in Ueno Park or feel the market snack atmosphere of Ameyoko.

With only two main stops each day and walking as the main mode, you can easily add or reduce according to your energy. Actual spending such as admission and meals has not been confirmed individually and remains unknown; this itinerary does not include flight arrangements.

activities.name: Senso-ji and Nakamise Shopping Street
activities.introduction: Pass through the Kaminarimon gate with its huge red lantern and you enter Tokyo's most famous old temple, Senso-ji. Legend says two fishermen brothers pulled a statue of Kannon from the Sumida River, and the temple was later built to enshrine it. Around the main hall you can see the five-story pagoda, smaller halls and gardens, and to the right of the main hall is Asakusa Shrine, dedicated to the three men who founded the temple. Beyond Kaminarimon, Nakamise Shopping Street is lined with shops selling traditional handicrafts, cotton-print kimono and various Japanese sweets.
activities.recommendationReason: Asakusa is a center of traditional Japanese handicrafts and culture, and it is the best single place to feel an old temple, a shopping street and Edo atmosphere together, well suited to a relaxed, strolling cultural itinerary.

activities.name: Asakusa dusk walk and Hoppy Street
activities.introduction: West of Senso-ji is Hoppy Street, named after the drink of the same name, with many open-air casual eateries where you can try local dishes such as freshly grilled chicken skewers. Here you also find Kamiya Bar, Japan's oldest Western-style bar. After sunset, the Senso-ji area is usually lit until night, a good way to take in the old temple's different evening mood.
activities.recommendationReason: This adds a low-intensity dusk experience for your interest in culture and history, letting you see the old temple at night and, along the way, experience the down-to-earth food culture of Asakusa that has continued since the postwar years.

activities.name: Meiji Shrine
activities.introduction: Completed in the 1920s, Meiji Shrine enshrines Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken, and stands amid lush greenery in central Tokyo. The roughly 100,000-tree forest around the shrine was donated from across Japan and planted by young volunteers; passing through the torii gate feels like leaving the city's noise behind. Within the grounds are an iris garden, scenic woodland paths, a classical Japanese tea house, and Kiyomasa's Well, regarded as a power spot. The shrine has plenty of English signage, making it easy for a first experience of shrine worship, ema votive plaques and omamori charms.
activities.recommendationReason: This is an ideal choice for a first shrine visit, combining deep history with natural calm, and matching your preference for culture, history and a relaxed pace.

activities.name: Tokyo National Museum
activities.introduction: Founded in the late nineteenth century, the Tokyo National Museum is Japan's oldest museum and is located in Ueno Park. Its collection is vast, covering many National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties, with large numbers of artifacts often on display. Exhibits span samurai armor and swords, Edo-period crafts, Noh and Kabuki, tea ceremony and Buddhism; behind the main building, a Japanese garden with a traditional tea house is open to the public.
activities.recommendationReason: To understand Japanese culture and history systematically, this is the broadest single stop, and indoor museum visiting is low-intensity, well suited to a relaxed cultural itinerary.

activities.name: Ueno Park and Ameyoko
activities.introduction: Ueno Park, beside Ueno Station, is the center of everything in Ueno; the park and its surroundings include Ueno Zoo, several museums and Kanei-ji Temple. The park's world-class art museums and galleries include the National Museum of Western Art, the Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum, the National Museum of Nature and Science, and the Shitamachi Museum, which introduces Tokyo life from over a century ago. On the south side of the park, Ameyoko gathers all kinds of market stalls and street snacks in a lively atmosphere.
activities.recommendationReason: In the same area as the Tokyo National Museum, this lets you link museums, history and street-level market culture into one relaxed day within the same green space, reducing back-and-forth travel.

第1天聚焦浅草：上午从雷门进入浅草寺，沿仲见世商店街慢行并尝街边小吃；午后至黄昏在隅田川一带散步，傍晚体验浅草寺亮灯与 Hoppy 街的市井饮食。

第2天上午前往明治神宫，在都市森林中的神社参拜、写绘马；午后转往上野公园内的东京国立博物馆，参观日本历史与工艺的馆藏；傍晚可在上野公园内慢走，或到阿美横丁感受市场小吃氛围。

每天仅两处主要停留、以步行为主，方便你按体力灵活增减。门票、餐饮等实际支出尚未逐一确认，仍属未知；本行程未包含航班安排。

activities.name: 浅草寺与仲见世商店街
activities.introduction: 穿过挂着巨大红灯笼的雷门，便进入东京最著名的古寺浅草寺。据传渔民兄弟在隅田川打鱼时捞起一尊观音像，寺院随后建成供奉。主殿周边可见五重塔、小殿与庭园，主殿右侧为供奉建寺三位男子的浅草神社。穿过雷门后的仲见世商店街商铺林立，贩售传统手工艺品、棉质印花和服与各式日式甜品。
activities.recommendationReason: 浅草是日本传统手工艺术与文化的中心，最能在一处同时感受古寺、商店街与江户风情，适合轻松漫步式的文化行程。

activities.name: 浅草黄昏散步与 Hoppy 街
activities.introduction: 浅草寺西侧有一条因同名饮料而闻名的 Hoppy 街，街上有多家露天休闲餐厅，可品尝即叫即烧的鸡肉串等当地料理。这里还有日本最古老的西式酒吧神谷酒吧。日落后的浅草寺一带通常亮灯至夜间，适合领略古寺晚间的别样情调。
activities.recommendationReason: 为喜欢文化与历史的你补充一段低强度的黄昏体验，既能看古寺夜色，也能顺路体验浅草战后延续至今的市井饮食文化。

activities.name: 明治神宫
activities.introduction: 明治神宫建成于上世纪二十年代，供奉明治天皇与昭宪皇太后，位于东京市中心却绿树成荫。神宫周边约十万棵树的森林由日本各地捐赠、年轻志愿者种植，穿过鸟居便仿佛与都市喧嚣隔绝。苑内有菖蒲花田、风景优美的林间小道、古典日式茶舍，以及被视为能量圣地的清正井。神宫内设有大量英文标识，方便初次体验神社参拜、绘马与护身符等传统仪式。
activities.recommendationReason: 这是首次参访神社的理想选择，兼具厚重历史与自然宁静，契合你对文化、历史与轻松节奏的偏好。

activities.name: 东京国立博物馆
activities.introduction: 东京国立博物馆成立于十九世纪后期，是日本历史最悠久的博物馆，位于上野公园内。馆藏规模庞大，涵盖众多国宝及重要文化财产，常有大量文物同时展出。展品涉及武士盔甲与刀剑、江户时代工艺、能剧歌舞伎、茶道与佛教等主题；主楼后方的日式庭园向公众开放，内有传统茶屋。
activities.recommendationReason: 想系统了解日本文化与历史，这里是覆盖面最广的一站，且博物馆室内参观强度低，适合轻松的文化行程。

activities.name: 上野公园与阿美横丁
activities.introduction: 上野公园位于上野车站旁，是上野一切体验的中心，公园及周边聚集了上野动物园、多座博物馆与宽永寺。公园内世界级的美术馆与画廊包括国立西洋美术馆、东京都美术馆、国立科学博物馆，以及介绍百余年前东京生活的下町风俗资料馆。公园南侧的阿美横丁汇集各式市场摊位与街边小吃，氛围热闹。
activities.recommendationReason: 与东京国立博物馆同区，可在同一片绿地内把博物馆、历史与街头市井文化连成轻松的一天，减少来回奔波。
